description: Replace the near-black + electric-lime theme with a deep-indigo/midnight palette and a refined blue (#4F8CFF) accent plus a new violet secondary accent (#A855F7). Apply in BOTH the CSS custom properties (src/index.css :root) and the Tailwind color config (tailwind.config.js), keeping every existing variable/key name so no utility class breaks, and ADD new accent-2 keys. Then replace every hardcoded old lime hex in components (found by grep) with the new blue. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (touches only styling/config + color literals), but ordered first so the whole app renders in the new theme.
steps: In src/index.css, inside the `:root` block, change values (keep names): --bg-color:#0B1020; --surface-color:#121832; --surface-elevated-color:#1A2142; --border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.09); --border-strong-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.18); --text-color and --foreground-color:#F2F4FF; --muted-color:#9AA3C7; --faint-color:#5A6291; --accent-color:#4F8CFF; --accent-soft-color:rgba(79,140,255,0.14); --accent-glow-color:rgba(79,140,255,0.35). ADD two new lines: --accent-2-color:#A855F7; --accent-2-soft-color:rgba(168,85,247,0.14).

In tailwind.config.js, inside theme.extend.colors, set the matching values on the existing keys: background:'#0B1020', surface:'#121832', 'surface-elevated':'#1A2142', border:'rgba(255,255,255,0.09)', 'border-strong':'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)', foreground:'#F2F4FF', muted:'#9AA3C7', faint:'#5A6291', accent:'#4F8CFF', 'accent-soft':'rgba(79,140,255,0.14)', 'accent-glow':'rgba(79,140,255,0.35)'. ADD 'accent-2':'#A855F7' and 'accent-2-soft':'rgba(168,85,247,0.14)'. Update the stale 'Logan-inspired' / 'electric lime' comments to describe the new palette.
src/components/avatar/Avatar3D.jsx: change the <pointLight ... color="#C6FF3D" /> to color="#4F8CFF", and in StaticAvatarFallback change the box shadow rgba(198,255,61,0.2) to rgba(79,140,255,0.2).
src/components/avatar/ProceduralBoy.jsx: in accentMaterial change both color:'#C6FF3D' and emissive:'#C6FF3D' to '#4F8CFF'.
src/components/ui/Button.jsx: in variantStyles.primary change shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(198,255,61,0.2)] to shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,140,255,0.2)] (leave the white hover shadow as-is).
src/pages/Projects.jsx: in the active category pill change shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(198,255,61,0.25)] to shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(79,140,255,0.25)].
src/components/ui/CustomCursor.jsx: replace both occurrences of '#C6FF3D' with '#4F8CFF' and rgba(198,255,61,0.4) with rgba(79,140,255,0.4).
